Text.Value: I'm really second-guessing whether you've got what it takes or not...
You sure you're cut out to be a Raider, let alone lead a bunch of 'em?
I'm worrying that you might be a little... soft.
You need to think about getting your shit together.
Are you serious with this? After the way you been acting? The hell's the matter with you?
Things are pretty fucking terrible, in case you hadn't noticed. Get your head outta your ass, boss.
Who the hell do you think you are? We're supposed to be in this for us, making sure we're taken care of.
I seen some guys go soft, but you... It's embarrassing. Get your shit together.
I'm really wishing you'd never made it out of the Gauntlet alive.
You're a friggin' disgrace, you know that?
We're good. We'd be better if we were getting rich and killing chumps instead of standing around yapping, but that's just me.
Us? Like you and me? We're okay, I suppose. Ain't thought too much about it.
Suppose we're doing all right. I ain't looking to bail out on you or nothin'.
Ehh, I can't complain, boss. I mean, I could always complain, but I guess I ain't got any real reason to.
Things are all right, I guess. Could use a little more action in my opinion, but you're the boss.
If nothin' else, I know I'm definitely backing the right horse.
For once, I don't mind taking orders from somebody.
Anything you ever need, I'm here for you.
You make one hell of an Overboss.
You know, I'd actually consider taking a bullet for you. Wouldn't do it, but I'd think about it for a second.
Anyone ever tell you your ass looks great in that Vault Suit?
Anything you ever need, I'm here for you.
I read something one time... This here'd be what you'd call an "inappropriate workplace relationship." Always breaking rules...
You know, you'll always be the Overboss of my hear.... ha ha ha! Oh man, I couldn't do it. Couldn't keep a straight face.
You're my kind of crazy, boss.
You know, I'd actually consider taking a bullet for you. Wouldn't do it, but I'd think about it for a second.
Sure thing, boss.
You're the Overboss.
Need somethin' from me?
Whatcha need?
Say the word, boss. I'm on it.
What do you need?
You got something for me, boss?
What's going on, boss?
Everything okay, boss?
I'm here if you need me.
You need anything, you just say the word.
I'm listening.
Need something?
You got orders?
You need something done, I'm your man.
You just say the word, boss.
I wanted to ask you about something else.
Show me what you got. (More Options)
Tell me about the options.
What else do you have? (More Options)
